title.zh: SmartLingo 可管理的钱包连接身份

purpose.zh: 将 SmartLingo 课程付款钱包发现切换到全站可管理的公开 Reown 项目，同时保留本站全部商务隔离边界。
purpose.en: Move SmartLingo course-payment wallet discovery to the portfolio-managed public Reown project while preserving every site-specific commerce boundary.

zh: 使用生产域名白名单已包含 smartlingo.net 的可管理 Reown WalletConnect Project ID。
增加契约测试，拒绝已停用的项目 ID 和依赖环境变量的钱包连接身份。
en: Use the managed Reown WalletConnect Project ID whose production domain allowlist includes smartlingo.net.
Add a contract test that rejects the retired project ID and environment-dependent WalletConnect identity.

zh: SmartLingo 课程加密结账与管理员付款界面的 WalletConnect 钱包发现
en: SmartLingo WalletConnect wallet discovery on course crypto checkout and admin payment surfaces

zh: 仅替换公开 Reown 项目标识；SmartLingo 课程、价格、合约、收款方、代币、密钥、数据及云资源均保持不变。
en: Replace only the public Reown project identifier; keep SmartLingo courses, prices, contracts, payees, tokens, keys, data, and cloud resources unchanged.

zh: 运行支付契约测试、完整自动测试、零警告 lint、生产构建和共享站点门禁。
未执行真实付款，也未启动实时音视频测试。
en: Run payment contract tests, the full automated suite, zero-warning lint, production build, and shared site gates.
No real payment was made and no realtime audio/video test was started.

zh: 真实钱包签名与链上付款由站点所有者按需执行。
en: Live wallet signing and on-chain payment remain owner-operated when needed.

zh: 适配 SmartLingo 按语言和课程授予三个月访问权的现有业务模型。
en: Adapted to the existing SmartLingo language- and course-scoped three-month access model.

rollback.zh: 回退至上一成功的 Cloudflare 部署；不涉及数据迁移。
rollback.en: Roll back to the previous successful Cloudflare deployment; no data migration is involved.
